name: Cloud CMA
shortDescription: Branded CMA reports from MLS comps, with a 14-day trial.
longDescription: Cloud CMA builds branded CMA reports from MLS comps, comparable sales, and neighborhood stats. Lone Wolf lists Cloud CMA at $49 per month, or $499 annually, and that price includes Homebeat. A 14-day trial is available. Many MLS memberships include Cloud CMA, and access still depends on the board.
pricingNotes: Cloud CMA is $49 per month or $499 annually, and that price includes Homebeat. A 14-day trial is available. Some MLS memberships include Cloud CMA.
bestFor: A branded CMA built from MLS comps and neighborhood stats
notIdealFor: An agent whose board does not include MLS access for Cloud CMA
strength: Cloud CMA builds a branded CMA from MLS comps and neighborhood stats, and a 14-day trial is available.
weakness: The $49 per month price includes Homebeat, and MLS comps are available only when the agent's board provides them.
smokeTestNotes: Product and comparison pages reviewed on October 27, 2026.
